versions.changelog:
ai-capsule 1.0.5

- Improved detection and handling of the "daily" trigger word: now only fires the digest for short, clear "daily" commands, reducing accidental activation in ordinary conversation.
- Added clarification and documentation for X/Twitter data fetching: now specifies reading local Chrome x.com cookies via browser-cookie3 and using a twitter-cli subprocess, with possible auto-detection of a 127.0.0.1 proxy.
- Updated documentation for input triggers and mode detection, especially distinguishing when to prompt for confirmation before fetching.
- Removed deprecated `skill-card.md` file.
X/Twitter data source support, proxy auto-detect, author/media fields

- Improved dependency management and fetch logic in requirements.txt and fetch.py.
- Updated daily summary or scoring behavior in sections/daily-mode.md.
- Refined source configuration in sources/ai.yaml.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file for a cleaner project structure.

- skill-card.md file removed for simplified documentation.
- Documentation files (README, README.zh, SKILL.md) updated for clarity and accuracy.
- Bumped version to 1.0.2.
- No behavior or feature changes to the skill’s logic or output.

ai-capsule 1.0.1

- README and user docs have been expanded for clarity, including triggers and supported sources.
- Improved SKILL.md with more concise summary, clearer first-time setup instructions, and explicit trigger word usage.
- Documentation for workflow and configuration steps is reorganized for easier setup and onboarding.
- The “skill-card.md” file has been removed as part of documentation cleanup.
- No changes to core functionality; this release focuses on improved documentation and user guidance.
